posts.title: Packing the infinite truck
posts.description: Imagine that everything needed for a move must travel in one truck. Capacity and correction # It is an ordinary truck, and it can return if something is forgotten. Because the truck can return, packing does not need to be perfect. That is useful. A forgotten box can still arrive. A mistake can be corrected.
